name: What types of cabinet materials are available for kitchen replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of cabinet materials are available for kitchen replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common cabinet materials include solid wood (like maple, oak, cherry), which offers durability and a classic look. Plywood, particleboard, and medium-density fiberboard (MDF) are often used for cabinet boxes and can be finished with veneers or laminates for a variety of styles. Melamine and thermofoil provide budget-friendly options with diverse finishes. For countertops and sometimes doors, engineered materials like quartz or laminates are popular. Each material offers different aesthetic, durability, and cost benefits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available materials include solid wood (maple, oak), plywood, particleboard, MDF, melamine, and thermofoil. Each offers different looks, durability, and price points.
